BARD-THE_BARD.title: The Bard
BARD-THE_BARD.description:
A wandering minstrel who fights with rhythm and rhyme.
Plays [gold]Songs[/gold] that strengthen the whole party.
BARD-THE_BARD.goldMonologue: [sine]A coin for the bard? Don't mind if I do![/sine]
BARD-THE_BARD.aromaPrinciple: [sine][purple]Every legend needs someone to sing it.[/purple][/sine]
